text.en: This Order m ay be cited as the Yayasan SuItan Haji HassanaI BoIkiah Act (Amendment of Schedule) Order, 2003 and shall be deemed to have commenced on the 5th. October, 1992 · Amendment of section 4 of Schedule to Chapter 166 ·

Section 4 of the ScheduIe to the Yayasan SuItan Haji HassanaI BoIkiah Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is amended ( 可 in subsection 《 2), by deleting " Deputy Chairman " from the first line and by substituting "first Deputy Chairman , second Deputy Chairman" therefor; (b ) in subsection (6)f by deleting " Deputy Chairman " from the last tw o lines and by substituting " first Deputy Chairman, and in case he is, at that time, unable to exercise those functions owing to any such causes, by the second Deputy Chairman until such time when either the Chairman or the first Deputy Chairman is able to exercise those functions, whichever is earlier" therefor; (c ) in subsection (7)f by deleting " the Deputy Chairman " from the last line and by substituting either of the Deputy Chairmen " therefor. Amendment of section 6 of ScheduIe.

Section 6 of the Schedule to the Act is amended, in subsection 《 6 ) ) by deleting the fullstop and by substituting a colon therefor; (b ) by adding the following proviso " Provi ded that , if such absence or inability is for a period Of less than 6 continuous calendar monthst the power to make any such appointment shall be vested in the Chairman who shall notify His 382 13th. SEPTEMBERI 2003 Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan of the appointment from time to time · Amendment of section 7 of ScheduIe.

Section 7 of the ScheduIe to th e Act is amended ( 可 in subsection (2)r by deleting " Deputy Chairman from the second line and by substituting " first Deputy Chairmanj second Deputy Chairman ' therefor ' (b ) in subsection (4), by deleting " and the Deputy Chairman " from the last line and by substituting 卯 , the first Deputy Chairman and the second Deputy Chairman , " therefor; (c ) by adding the following 5 new subsections The members of the Committee of Governors shall be appointed from among subjects of His Majesty the SuItan and Yang Di-Pertuan who are Muslims according to Ahli Sunnah wai-Jamaah · ( 7 〕 If the Chairman is unable to exercise his functions under this Constitution owing to illness, absence from Brunei Darussalam or fo r any other cause whatsoever his functions shall be exercised by the first Deputy Chairman, and in case he is, at that time, unable to exercise those functions owing to any such causes, by the second Deputy Chairman until such time when either the Chairman or the first Deputy Chairman is able to exercise those functions, whichever IS earlier. 罔 The Chairman shall summon meetings as often as may be required and at every meeting of the Committee of Governors, a quorum shall consist of 3 members, including the Chairman or either of the Deputy Chairmen. ( 9 ) The Chairman shall have a casting vote in the event of an equality of votes. 〖 io ) The Committee of Governors may invite any person as it thinks fi t to attend a meeting of the Committee of Governors fo r the purpose Of giving advice to the Committee Of Governors on any matter · 383

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE Made this 28th. day of Jamadilakhir, 1424 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. d ay of August, 2003 at Our lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN ,
